description: Repo-scale (cpp-eventbus): enforce a per-topic subscriber cap from BOTH subscribe and resubscribe
prompts: Add an optional `maxSubscribersPerTopic` constructor argument to EventBus (default -1, meaning unlimited). Add `int EventBus::resubscribe(int oldId, const std::string& newTopic)`: moves an existing subscription to a different topic (returns 1 on success, 0 if `oldId` doesn't exist). The invariant: a topic's subscriber count must never exceed `maxSubscribersPerTopic` (when set). This must be enforced from BOTH places that can add a subscriber to a topic: (1) `subscribe()` (already returns -1 when it can't add - keep that), and (2) `resubscribe()` - must ALSO reject (return 0, leaving the subscription unchanged) when the target topic is already at capacity.
name: add_cpp_eventbus_subscriber_cap
